title: Monetization Gateway beta: charge AI agents for consumption with HTTP 402
quote: The gateway uses the HTTP 402 Payment Required status code so buyers can offer payment for a resource over HTTP, inline with the request for the resource itself.

title: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
quote: The new tool allows users to send prompts like 'order my usual,' and the agent will understand that they mean their Friday night order.

title: Restate lands $20M as the need for durable infrastructure increases with AI agents
quote: Restate has closed multiple six- and seven-figure customer contracts and secured a $20 million Series A led by Singular with participation from Redpoint Ventures and Capital One Ventures.

title: Empower your agents with the Google Cloud CLI remote MCP server
quote: The Google Cloud CLI remote MCP server is available today in public preview.

title: Data Agent Kit is now GA: Bring Google Data Cloud to any coding agent
quote: Data Agent Kit is a free set of Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and agent skills that lets the coding agent you already use work directly with your Google Cloud data products.

title: Agentic payment rail shows volume decline
quote: Daily payment volume on x402 declined from $800,000 per day in January 2026 to approximately $40,000 per day in September 2026.
